inputs.name: hand over from Canary and A/B Testing to Model Serving Endpoint

output.level_0: Canary traffic crashes the endpoint, leaving stores with stale forecasts during the order window.
output.level_1: No handover exists, so new models never reach the serving layer for production use.
output.level_2: Engineers manually copy validated models to the endpoint after a successful test period.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically promotes the winning model to the endpoint after passing checks.
output.level_4: Governance gates verify compliance and rollback plans before automated promotion to the endpoint.
